title: Synthetic Data & Data-Centric AI
tagline: Improve models by improving their data: find label errors, label less, augment, generate synthetic tables and LLM training sets, and know when synthetic data backfires.
prereqs: Machine Learning. Deep Learning helps for the GAN and VAE step; Fine-Tuning & Reasoning Models helps for the LLM steps.

steps.title: From model-centric to data-centric AI
steps.why: Andrew Ng's case for fixing data quality before tuning the model.

steps.title: Find label errors
steps.why: MIT lecture on confident learning: spot mislabeled examples automatically.

steps.title: Dataset creation and curation
steps.why: MIT lecture on sourcing, labeling, and cleaning a dataset.

steps.title: Active learning
steps.why: Let the model choose which examples are worth labeling next.

steps.title: Weak supervision
steps.why: Combine noisy heuristic rules into training labels with Snorkel.

steps.title: Data augmentation
steps.why: Flips, crops, and color shifts that stretch a small image dataset.

steps.title: What synthetic data is
steps.why: Generated data that keeps real data's patterns, and where it helps.

steps.title: Synthetic tables with SDV
steps.why: Generate single- and multi-table data with copulas and GANs.

steps.title: CTGAN and TVAE in Python
steps.why: The theory behind two tabular generators, then code using both.

steps.title: Synthetic datasets for LLM fine-tuning
steps.why: Turn your documents into QA and reasoning pairs with a CLI.

steps.title: Curating data for LLM post-training
steps.why: Lessons from building the OpenThoughts reasoning dataset.

steps.title: Model collapse
steps.why: What can go wrong when models train on model-generated data.

projects: Run cleanlab on a public text classification dataset, review the 50 most suspicious labels by hand, and report how many were truly wrong.
Generate a synthetic copy of a tabular dataset with SDV, then compare a model trained on synthetic data with one trained on real data.
Create 200 QA pairs from your own notes with synthetic-data-kit, filter out the bad ones, and publish the dataset on Hugging Face.
